lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Kiko, did Mr. Reyes give you the manuscript guidelines?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Yes, Ma'am. Numbered lists for student demands and bullet points for supporting arguments.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Good. Head over to the Office Computer and format the editorial draft accordingly.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Once you finish, let me review it before we hand it over to Mr. Reyes.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Have you finished formatting the demands and evidence on the computer yet?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Make sure every demand is numbered and every supporting point is bulleted.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Let's see how you formatted our official editorial stance.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: The structure is clear, professional, and undeniable.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Now bring this copy directly to Mr. Reyes in the Admin Office for final sign-off.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Be meticulous with the formatting. Mr. Reyes will reject anything less than perfect.
